question: Which office of an organization may change its profile, contact details, settings, parent affiliation and lifecycle status (including archiving the organization), who verifies a change of parent, and which fields of an organization record (contacts, billing contact, settings, member counts, hierarchy position) may a signed-in user of another organization read?
decision: Org admins edit non-sensitive profile and contact fields within an allow-list; finance, parent affiliation and security settings obey their separate mandate rules. Archiving requires tenant-authorized officer decision plus second review, contract/retention/legal-hold checks, reversible grace period and independent audit; platform staff cannot unilaterally archive a tenant for convenience. Parent changes require verified approval from both organizations. Other tenants see only explicitly public directory fields, not parent details unless published.
originalProposedDecision: Org admins change profile, contact and settings. Archiving needs two admins or platform staff. A parent change needs both orgs' admins to confirm. Other orgs read only name, type, province and parent; never contacts, billing contact, settings or counts.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
approvedByRole: Founder & Product Owner, Nzila OS (Nzila Ventures) — platform/product only; contracting legal name unverified
